newsitem.title: USA: Alabama legislature approves $80 mln GO referendum.
newsitem.headline: Alabama legislature approves $80 mln GO referendum.

text.p: Alabama's House of Representatives has approved a referendum on an $80 million general obligation bond issue for state parks.
The proposal passed unanimously Tuesday and was previously approved in the Senate.
It now goes to Gov. Fob James, who supports it.
If voters approve, the bonds would be repaid from sales tax revenues the state receives under a 1996 executive order by James.

The order limited the amount of money that large retailers can keep for collecting sales taxes for the state to $900 a month, directing anything above that to the state Department of Conservation and Natural Resources. Under the order, the department receives about $750,000 a month.
